exposure: Infants not exposed to maternal preeclampsia
cohort: 13,490 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants born between 1997 and 2014 from the database of the Premature Baby Foundation of Taiwan
finding: Maternal preeclampsia slightly increases the risk of severe RDS in VLBW infants after adjusting for confounders.
gest_age: Mean gestational age of 30.7 weeks in the preeclamptic group and 28.6 weeks in the control group
